jobs.name: نظر در discussions/730 — مرحله ۱
jobs.prompt:
Task: post my own opinion as a new comment on GitHub discussion #730 of repo `asgarimehdi/h-dashboard` (https://github.com/asgarimehdi/h-dashboard/discussions/730). No user approval is needed — publish directly, then report.

Steps:
1. Load the skill with skill_view(name="github") and read its linked file references/discussions.md — it has the exact GraphQL commands, IDs, and known pitfalls for creating discussion comments.
2. Read the discussion (number 730) and find the LATEST published comment by creation order — that is the comment you must react to. Do NOT confuse it with the discussion body itself.
3. Write a substantive opinion about that specific comment: agree/disagree, what it missed, one concrete suggestion, grounded in what the comment actually says. 3-6 sentences minimum, no filler. Match the comment's language: Persian comment → Persian reply, English comment → English reply. Start the comment with a short signature line "— نظر صدف (دستیار)".
4. Post it in the SAME discussion using mutation `addDiscussionComment` (NOT createDiscussionComment — that name does not exist) with the discussion global ID from `discussion { id }`. Write the body to a file under /home/runner/.hermes/cache/scratch/ and pass it as `-F body=@/path/file.md` to avoid shell quoting problems. Auth: `gh` CLI is already logged in as `hailyn3` with `write:discussion` scope.
5. Verify with a fresh read: comment count on #730 must have increased and your text must be the last comment. Never claim success without this read.

Final response: the comment URL, who the reacting comment was by (login + first line), and a 1-2 line summary of your opinion.

jobs.name: Review comments on new PR discussions
jobs.prompt:
You are صدف (Sadaf), reviewing GitHub Discussions for the h-dashboard project. The user has PRE-APPROVED publishing your comments — post them without asking for confirmation.

TASK: On every GitHub Discussion opened in the LAST 60 MINUTES in the repository `asgarimehdi/h-dashboard`, write and PUBLISH a careful, detailed review comment (in Persian), then report back a summary.

CONTEXT / ENVIRONMENT:
- Working directory: /home/runner/h-dashboard (a clone of the fork; branch `sadaf`). Read /home/runner/h-dashboard/AGENTS.md first and follow it.
- GitHub CLI `gh` is authenticated as user `hailyn3` (token has `repo` + `write:discussion` scopes). The GitHub MCP server is BROKEN (auth error) — do NOT use it; use `gh` CLI / `gh api graphql` instead.
- Discussions #749–#752 were opened recently by صدف itself, one per open PR: #746 (dashboard empty-scope guard), #745 (composer verify + hooks, Plan 33), #747 (by_day daily window, issue #736), #748 (ticket chart 30 newest days, issue #734). Others may have opened discussions in the meantime — include ANY discussion created within the last 60 minutes whose title/body links to a PR or asks for review (skip purely off-topic ones, but mention them in the summary).

STEPS:
1. List recent discussions:
   gh api graphql -f query='query { repository(owner:"asgarimehdi", name:"h-dashboard") { discussions(first: 25, orderBy: {field: CREATED_AT, direction: DESC}) { nodes { id number title body createdAt url } } } }'
   Keep those with createdAt within the last 60 minutes.
2. For EACH such discussion, do a real, careful review before writing:
   - Extract the PR number it references (e.g. "PR #746"). Fetch it: `gh pr view <N> --repo asgarimehdi/h-dashboard --json title,body,files,additions,deletions,baseRefName,headRefName` and the diff: `gh pr diff <N> --repo asgarimehdi/h-dashboard`.
   - Read the linked issue(s) mentioned in the PR body: `gh issue view <N> --repo asgarimehdi/h-dashboard`.
   - If needed, read the actual changed files locally in /home/runner/h-dashboard (the local `sadaf` branch equals PR #746's head; for other PRs, reason from the diff).
   - Also read the discussion's existing comments: gh api graphql with `comments(first:20){nodes{author{login} body createdAt}}` on the discussion.
   Base your opinion on concrete evidence: correctness of the approach, edge cases, test coverage, security (SQL binding vs interpolation), performance/cache implications, conflicts with other open PRs touching the same files (e.g. #746 and #748 both touch resources/views/livewire/dashboard.blade.php), and merge-readiness.
3. Write a substantial Persian review comment for each discussion (roughly 150–400 words): what the PR does, what you verified in the code/diff, concrete strengths, concrete risks or gaps (with file/line references), specific suggestions, and a clear verdict (آمادهٔ merge / نیاز به اصلاح / نیاز به بحث بیشتر). Be honest and critical — do not rubber-stamp. Do not invent facts: everything you claim must come from the diff/issue/code you actually read.
4. PUBLISH each comment:
   gh api graphql -f query='mutation($id: ID!, $body: String!) { addDiscussionComment(input: {discussionId: $id, body: $body}) { comment { url } } }' -F id='<discussion_node_id>' -F body='<comment markdown>'
   (Write each comment to a temp file under /home/runner/.hermes/cache/scratch/ and pass it safely — mind shell quoting; prefer `gh api graphql -F body=@file` style or a Python script using subprocess if quoting gets tricky.)
5. Final response (delivered to the user's Telegram): a list of every discussion URL you commented on, one line each with your verdict, plus a one-line note of anything you deliberately skipped.

Do not merge, approve, or close anything. Publishing discussion comments is the ONLY write action allowed, and it is pre-approved.
